content:
Updates the specified user-defined template.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role or the WAS.SCAN_WAS_USER_TEMPLATE.MANAGE  custom
role privilege. Additionally, requires the Can Edit [64] scan permission. See Roles and Permissions.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
Content type
string <uuid>
The UUID of the user-defined template.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
required
Specifies the updates you want to make to a user-defined template.
string
The name of the user-defined template.
string
The description for the user-defined template.
string <uuid>
The UUID of the owner of the user-defined template.
string (PermissionLevel)
Enum: "no_access"
"view"
"control"
"configure"
The scan permissions level, as described in Permissions.
string (ResultsVisibility)
Default: "dashboard"
Enum: "private"
"dashboard"
The visibility of the results (private or dashboard).
Array of objects (Permissions)
The permissions for the user-defined template.
